sentences.text: Learned counsel for the Applicant submitted the medical evidence does not support the prosecution case and that the evidence is not reliable.
The Applicant was on bail, during trial, therefore, he be granted bail.
3. Learned APP for the State, and learned counsel for the Respondent No.2 opposed these submissions.
They pointed out that the date of birth of the victim was 23rd June 2009 and the incident took place on 3rd February 2016.
Therefore, the victim was about six and half years of age.
There was no reason to implicate the Applicant falsely.
4. Mr. Patil, appearing for the Applicant submitted that there was delay in lodging the FIR.
5. I find that there is nothing brought on record to point out as to why a young girl of tender age would depose falsely against the Applicant.
The Medical Officer has not given any specific clear evidence of sexual assault or ruptured hymen.
This fact will have to be examined at the final hearing stage.
6. At this stage, for consideration of bail pending appeal, no 3/3 7-ia-165-2023.odt case is made out by the Applicant.
7. The application is rejected.

8. The appeal is expedited.
(SARANG V. KOTWAL, J.)
